releaseNotes: New: added support for the Sunton "ESP32-8048S070" 7" display (catalog ID esp32-7-sunton) -- a genuinely different physical board from the existing 7" model despite the near-identical name (different PCLK pin, sync timing, and touch controller wiring). The previous single "esp32-7" catalog entry is renamed to esp32-7-elecrow to disambiguate; existing esp32-7-elecrow units are unaffected other than the internal ID change.
